name: Wavethrashing
label: Quest
description: Wavethrashing: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The wavethrasher is an amphibious beast living only here in Azshara. They are powerful and resilient.
The tough, reflective scales from a wavethrasher mirror the strength of the hunter.
Track and hunt wavethrashers along the coast of Azshara, and bring me their scales.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The wavethrashers are not easily defeated, even more so in their watery environment.
You have proven yourself ready to hunt even deadlier prey.
